title: Meta’s $18bn Settlement Sparks Global Calls for Child Safety
subtitle: Following a major legal deal in the US, governments around the world are pushing for stricter protections for young social media users.

summary.en: Meta has agreed to pay $18 billion to settle a lawsuit with 29 US states regarding the safety of young users. The company will now implement new features like daily time limits and overnight blocks for children in the US. UK officials are now demanding that these same protections be applied to British teenagers. Other countries, including France and Indonesia, are also moving forward with their own bans or restrictions on social media for minors. Experts believe this settlement shows that tech companies are feeling increased pressure to change their platforms.
summary.zh: Meta 已同意支付 180 億美元，就 29 個美國州針對年輕用戶安全問題所提起的訴訟達成和解。該公司現在將為美國兒童實施每日時間限制與夜間封鎖等新功能。英國官員目前要求將這些保護措施同樣應用於英國青少年。包括法國與印尼在內的其他國家，也正推進各自針對未成年人的社群媒體禁令或限制。專家認為，這項和解顯示科技公司正感受到改變其平台的壓力日益增加。

paragraphs.en: Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, has reached a major $18 billion settlement with 29 US states. This deal ends a legal battle where states accused the company of creating addictive products that harm young people. As part of the agreement, Meta will introduce new safety measures, including daily time limits and blocks on usage during the night. While the company has not admitted to any wrongdoing, these changes represent a significant shift in how one of the world’s largest tech firms manages its platforms.
paragraphs.zh: 臉書 (Facebook) 與 Instagram 的母公司 Meta，已與美國 29 個州達成一項金額高達 180 億美元的和解協議。這項協議終結了一場法律訴訟，各州指控該公司開發出會對年輕人造成傷害的成癮性產品。作為協議的一部分，Meta 將引入新的安全措施，包括每日使用時間限制以及夜間使用封鎖功能。雖然該公司並未承認任何不當行為，但這些變革顯示這家全球最大的科技公司之一，在管理其平台的方式上出現了重大轉變。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Technology, the UK government is now calling for Meta to apply these same protections to children in Britain. Pat McFadden, the UK work and pensions secretary, stated that the government does not want young people in the US to have a higher level of protection than those in the UK. The proposed changes include a default two-hour daily limit for users under 18 and a block on notifications during the school day. These measures go beyond existing UK plans, which include a broader social media ban for children under 16 set to begin in 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報科技版》(The Guardian Technology) 報導，英國政府目前正要求 Meta 對英國的兒童採取同樣的保護措施。英國就業及退休保障大臣麥法登 (Pat McFadden) 表示，政府不希望美國年輕人享有的保護程度高於英國的年輕人。擬議的變更包括為 18 歲以下用戶設定預設每日兩小時的使用上限，以及在學校上課期間封鎖通知。這些措施比英國現有的計畫更進一步，英國原定於 2027 年開始對 16 歲以下兒童實施更廣泛的社群媒體禁令。

paragraphs.en: BBC Business reports that while these new features currently apply only to the US, there is a strong possibility they will expand globally. Former Meta director Zvika Krieger noted that the company likely agreed to these changes because it saw the "writing on the wall" regarding future regulations. Meta itself has encouraged other platforms, such as TikTok and YouTube, to adopt similar standards. The company argues that it wants a "level playing field," meaning it does not want to be the only company restricted while its competitors remain free to attract young users without these limits.
paragraphs.zh: BBC 商業新聞報導指出，雖然這些新功能目前僅適用於美國，但極有可能會推廣至全球。前 Meta 主管克里格 (Zvika Krieger) 指出，該公司之所以同意這些變更，很可能是因為預見了未來法規的「必然趨勢」。Meta 本身也鼓勵 TikTok 和 YouTube 等其他平台採取類似標準。該公司主張，它希望建立一個「公平競爭環境」，意即它不希望成為唯一受到限制的公司，而競爭對手卻能不受這些限制地吸引年輕用戶。

paragraphs.en: This settlement comes at a time when many countries are taking action to protect minors online. The Guardian World notes that countries like Indonesia, Malaysia, France, and Turkey have already passed laws to ban or limit social media access for children. The Tech Policy Press suggests that nearly 20 other nations are currently considering similar rules. These global efforts reflect a growing concern about how algorithms—the systems that decide what content users see—can influence the mental health and behavior of teenagers.
paragraphs.zh: 這項和解案正值許多國家採取行動保護線上未成年人之際。《衛報世界版》(The Guardian World) 指出，印尼、馬來西亞、法國和土耳其等國已經通過法律，禁止或限制兒童使用社群媒體。《科技政策新聞》(Tech Policy Press) 則指出，目前另有近 20 個國家正在考慮制定類似規則。這些全球性的努力反映出人們日益擔憂演算法（即決定用戶看到什麼內容的系統）如何影響青少年的心理健康與行為。

paragraphs.en: However, some critics argue that these settlements do not address the deeper problems caused by big technology companies. The Guardian World highlighted the case of Abrham Meareg, who is suing Meta over its role in the death of his father in Ethiopia. Meareg’s case focuses on how Facebook’s algorithm promoted harmful content during a civil war. His lawyers argue that Meta has often avoided responsibility for the real-world impact of its platforms. For people like Meareg, the focus on US child safety is only one part of a much larger issue regarding the power and lack of accountability of global tech giants.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一些批評者認為，這些和解案並未解決大型科技公司所造成的更深層問題。《衛報世界版》特別報導了梅雷格 (Abrham Meareg) 的案例，他正因其父親在衣索比亞遇害一事控告 Meta。梅雷格的案件聚焦於臉書的演算法如何在內戰期間推播有害內容。他的律師主張，Meta 經常逃避其平台對現實世界造成影響的責任。對於像梅雷格這樣的人來說，對美國兒童安全的關注，僅是全球科技巨頭權力過大且缺乏問責機制這一更大問題的一小部分。

paragraphs.en: Legal experts are watching these developments closely. James Grimmelmann, a professor at Cornell University, told The Guardian Technology that the settlement is a sign of "vulnerability" for Meta. It shows that courts and governments are becoming more willing to challenge the tech industry. While Meta’s share price rose after the deal was announced—suggesting that investors were relieved the company avoided a much larger fine—the long-term impact on its business model remains uncertain.
paragraphs.zh: 法律專家正密切關注這些發展。康乃爾大學 (Cornell University) 教授格里梅爾曼 (James Grimmelmann) 向《衛報科技版》表示，這項和解是 Meta 顯露「脆弱性」的跡象。這顯示法院與政府正變得更願意挑戰科技產業。雖然 Meta 的股價在協議宣布後上漲，顯示投資人對於該公司避免了更巨額的罰款感到鬆了一口氣，但這對其商業模式的長期影響仍充滿不確定性。

paragraphs.en: As the UK and other nations push for more control, the pressure on social media companies will likely increase. Whether these platforms can effectively protect young users while maintaining their business growth is a question that remains unanswered. For now, the focus remains on whether Meta will voluntarily roll out its US safety features to the rest of the world, or if governments will be forced to pass new laws to make those changes happen. As Trevor Johnson, a former senior figure at Meta, told BBC Business, these platforms rarely change unless they are told to do so by regulators.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著英國與其他國家推動更嚴格的控管，社群媒體公司面臨的壓力可能會持續增加。這些平台是否能在維持業務成長的同時有效保護年輕用戶，仍是一個未解的問題。目前，焦點在於 Meta 是否會主動將其美國的安全功能推廣至全球，或者政府是否將被迫通過新法來強制執行這些變更。正如前 Meta 資深主管強森 (Trevor Johnson) 向 BBC 商業新聞所言，除非受到監管機構的要求，否則這些平台鮮少會主動改變。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Restrictions or prohibitions that prevent something from happening or being accessed.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（阻擋），這裡作名詞表示限制措施。文中：As part of the agreement, Meta will introduce new safety measures, including daily time limits and blocks on usage during the night.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A sign that something bad or unpleasant is going to happen in the future.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 不祥之兆，預示未來會有壞事發生。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個慣用語，字面意思無法推導出含義。文中：Former Meta director Zvika Krieger noted that the company likely agreed to these changes because it saw the "writing on the wall" regarding future regulations.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation in which everyone has the same fair chance of succeeding.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個商業慣用語，指競爭條件對所有參與者都公平。文中：The company argues that it wants a "level playing field," meaning it does not want to be the only company restricted while its competitors remain free to attract young users without these limits.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To introduce a new product or service to the public for the first time.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 推出（新產品、服務或政策）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見的片語，指大規模地推行某事。文中：For now, the focus remains on whether Meta will voluntarily roll out its US safety features to the rest of the world, or if governments will be forced to pass new laws to make those changes happen.

previousArticles.title: Meta Reaches Major Settlement Over Child Safety Concerns
previousArticles.summaryEn: Meta has agreed to an $18 billion settlement with nearly every US state to resolve claims that its platforms harm children. The company will introduce new safety features, including time limits and better parental controls. While Meta does not admit to any wrongdoing, the deal marks a significant moment for the tech industry. Experts believe these changes could set a global standard for social media regulation. Other companies like TikTok and YouTube now face pressure to adopt similar safety measures.

quiz.question: What specific safety measures are proposed for users under 18 in the UK, as mentioned in the article?

options.A: A total ban on social media use for those under 16 by 2027.
options.B: A default two-hour daily limit and a block on notifications during school hours.
options.C: A complete ban on all social media usage during the night.
options.D: A requirement for parental consent before accessing any Meta platforms.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，英國政府提出的新措施包含針對 18 歲以下用戶的每日兩小時限制，以及在校期間封鎖通知。選項 A 雖然提到了 2027 年的禁令，但那是英國既有的計畫，而非本次提議的「新」保護措施。選項 C 的夜間封鎖是美國協議的一部分，而非英國提出的具體內容。選項 D 文中並未提及。

quiz.question: Why does Meta want other platforms like TikTok and YouTube to adopt the same safety standards it has agreed to?

options.A: Meta wants to improve its public reputation by leading a global safety initiative.
options.B: Meta believes that competitors have better technology to enforce these rules.
options.C: Meta wants to avoid a competitive disadvantage where it is the only company restricted.
options.D: Meta is legally required by the US courts to force its competitors to change.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，Meta 提倡「公平競爭環境」（level playing field），意即不希望自己成為唯一受到限制的公司，而讓競爭對手能自由吸引年輕用戶。選項 A 雖然 Meta 可能有此考量，但文章明確指出其動機是為了商業競爭公平性。選項 B 文中未提及對手技術較好。選項 D 錯誤，法院並未要求 Meta 去規範競爭對手。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the phrase 'writing on the wall' mean?

options.A: A clear sign that something bad or inevitable is going to happen.
options.B: A formal written warning issued by a government regulatory body.
options.C: A secret agreement made between tech companies and the government.
options.D: A literal message displayed on the office walls of Meta executives.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。「Writing on the wall」是一個慣用語，意指預示未來災難或不可避免的結局的跡象。文中提到 Meta 前主管認為公司同意改變是因為看到了未來法規趨勢的「徵兆」。選項 B 錯誤，這不是指正式的警告信。選項 C 與 D 皆為字面上的誤解，與原文語境不符。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article regarding Meta's recent settlement?

options.A: The financial success of Meta's stocks following the legal settlement.
options.B: The specific legal arguments used by Abrham Meareg against Meta in Ethiopia.
options.C: The global trend of increasing pressure on tech giants to prioritize user safety over growth.
options.D: The technical details of how Meta's algorithms influence the mental health of teenagers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文從 Meta 的和解案出發，延伸討論到英國的跟進、全球各國的立法趨勢，以及對科技巨頭缺乏責任感的批評，核心主旨皆圍繞在社會對科技公司施加壓力，要求其在商業成長與用戶安全間取得平衡。選項 A 僅是文中一小部分的觀察；選項 B 是用來佐證科技巨頭缺乏責任感的案例，非全文核心；選項 D 僅是背景因素，並非文章探討的主軸。
